title: Asset Inventory Management (AIM) Standard – Overview and Quick Reference
question: What does the AIM Standard require for asset categories, criticality assessment and asset lifecycle?
summary: Condensed guide to the Asset Inventory Management (AIM) Standard v1.2: roles, service types, asset categories 1, 2, 2N and 3, impact and condition scoring, the criticality matrix, associated compliance, mandatory attributes, review frequencies and the add and retire asset workflows.
